text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While I'm waiting for
<chrname> to
show up...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that looks really painful! What
happened
to your nail, Flash?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It got slightly chipped during gym class.
It's
nothing to fuss about.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I dunno, like, you should probably take
that more
seriously. Want me to fix it
up? I've got my kit
with me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is no time for that. We have less
than three
minutes until our run.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And afterwards, we have a joint dance
lesson, so I
won't be able to tend to my
nails until that is
over.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat? Why would you put it off like
that? It's
really gonna suck if that nail
gets worse.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Will you let me fix your nails
if I win
our race?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Very well... But then if I win, we shall
follow our
schedule to a tee.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Nails have power, you know!
Better not
take that power lightly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race between Tosen Jordan and
Eishin Flash
looks as if it'll go down to
the wire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But when Eishin Flash squeezes her fists
in
preparation for the final straight...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... I-I win.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Flash! Didn't you say "ow" right at
the end
of the race?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It appears that I squeezed my fist a little
too
hard.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seeeee? I told you that you gotta take
care of
your nails.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I should've listened. I will prioritize
maintaining
them.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm glad you got the message! All
right, I'll
have you fixed up in juuust a
sec!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: There. All done! Do you love it or what?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised. Not only do my nails look
better...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But it doesn't hurt at all when I squeeze
my fist.
Now I won't have to hold back
during my final
spurt.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Riiiiight? I'm, like, literally a pro.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you very much. By the way,
what
kind of tools do you—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey! No peeking! Gotta keep my
industry
secrets under wraps!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The nail supplies that Tosen Jordan is
trying to
hide come tumbling out.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A manicure set for sports, I see.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. Uh, well... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see. So your nails are not simply for
show.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They're part of a secret strategy to
maximize
power, since victory is
determined by the smallest
of margins.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I planned this or anything...
You're,
like, giving me too much credit
here...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No. I appreciate you revealing the truth
to me
through this experience.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, something like that. I don't mind
if you've
got some respect for me now,
y'know.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will keep this in mind and repay you
one day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yes! I'm planning to bake some
Schneeballen
tomorrow. Please do have
some.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, for real? Those sound so chic. I'm totes down!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It's all about being chic, okay? Don't
forget
that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh. I'm, like, so tired! Time to go buy
some new
nail polish colors!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Both practical and gorgeous... I see. A
lesson well
learned.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, chill! It's not like I'm all passion or
whatevs,
you know? I just like to do
nails...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It smells... It stinks... It reeks... of
someone in the
THROES of youth!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what the... Where'd you come
from, Golshi?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, mon ami! Someone's embarrassed! But who's the perp? Is it you?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ew, why are you acting like that? That's
low-key
annoying.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The suspect's on the run! Zut alors! But
the shrewd
detective Golshi the Great is
on the case!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Jordan appears to be troubled by Golshi
chasing
her...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Now is my chance to repay that debt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash rescues Tosen Jordan, who comments that "what goes around totes comes around."
